title: Normalized derived comparison for realized etale scalar adjunctions
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, $\Lambda$ any commutative ring, and suppose the unbounded derived categories of ringed module sheaves on their lifted small etale sites are given [def-pur-etale-ringed-projection-presentation]. Let $d$ be a geometric scalar-extension datum [def-sfb-constant-module-geometric-comparison-data], with ExactData $x$ and OrdinaryIdentification $o$. Suppose specified equalities identify its fixed-coefficient inverse and direct images with the transported published module inverse and direct images, and identify its fixed-coefficient adjunction with the transported published adjunction. For $T=X,Y$, prescribe NativeOrdinaryTensorData $m_T$ and its normalized NativeTensorData $c_T$. Prescribe ringed tensor models $a$ on $Y$ and $b$ on $X$ with ModelNormalized, so their representative isomorphisms are inverse localization tensorators. Then there exists NativeIdentification $e$ [def-pur-etale-ringed-derived-identification-data]: left and right derived scalar comparison isomorphisms satisfying NativeLeftNormalization and NativeRightNormalization [def-pur-etale-ringed-derived-normalization], identifying the full derived Hom bijections, units and counits and the normalized pullback tensor square. Moreover its derived pullback comultiplication equals the canonical edge tensor comparison for $a,b$ on every pair of derived objects, and PublishedProjectionSquare commutes on every unbounded pair $E,L$. Thus transporting the edge adjunct of tensor comparison followed by counit tensor identity gives precisely the published native projection morphism. No projection map is inverted. This assertion assumes the ordinary geometric and corner tensor data and constructs only their normalized derived comparison.

proof.text: Localize the exact ordinary inverse-image square and compare the universal left-derived extensions. The right-derived square is computed on K-injective resolutions, preserved by each exact equivalence. The normalization equations are the localization factorization and right-derived-unit factorization of these constructions.

Compute the canonical derived Hom bijection on a representing source complex and a K-injective target. It is localization, ordinary adjunction, then localization back. The OrdinaryIdentification Hom equation and displayed fixed adjunction identify these composites. Evaluation on identity maps supplies the unit and counit equations.

Transfer the ordinary scalar-extension monoidal structure through the exact scalar equivalence. On flat-term K-flat pairs the signed-total comparison has the same scalar-one insertion in each bidegree as the published inverse-image comparison. Resolve both variables and descend that equality to all unbounded objects. This supplies RingedPullbackTensorData and the tensor square with its total normalization. Compare its derived tensorator with the canonical ringed edge tensor comparison on the prescribed normalized corner models: their representative squares agree, so fully faithful resolving restriction identifies the natural transformations.

Transpose the tensor square followed by counit tensor identity using the Hom comparison. This proves the specified projection square without inverting a projection morphism. There are no boundedness or finiteness hypotheses, and the argument includes the zero ring and identity map.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_ringed_native_derived_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules (topology Y) Λ)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules (topology X) Λ)]
    (d : GeometricData (topology Y) (topology X) Λ) (x : ExactData d)
    (o : OrdinaryIdentification d)
    (hL : d.pullA = transportedInverse f (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hR : d.pushA = transportedDirect f (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (mY : NativeOrdinaryTensorData Y Λ) (mX : NativeOrdinaryTensorData X Λ)
    (cY : NativeTensorData Y Λ mY.braided) (cX : NativeTensorData X Λ mX.braided)
    (hAdj : HEq d.fixedAdj
      ((nativeEquivalence Y Λ).symm.toAdjunction.comp
        ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).comp
          (nativeEquivalence X Λ).toAdjunction)))
    (a : SheafOfModules.RingedTensorModel (corner Y Λ))
    (b : SheafOfModules.RingedTensorModel (corner X Λ))
    (ha : ModelNormalized Y Λ a) (hb : ModelNormalized X Λ b) :
    ∃ e : NativeIdentification f Λ d x o hL hR mY mX cY cX,
      (∀ M N : DerivedCategory (Modules (topology Y) Λ),
        @Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ _ _ _ _ _ _ d.pullR.mapDerivedCategory
          e.tensor.val.1.toOplaxMonoidal M N =
          ((edge Λ d x).tensorComparison a b).hom.app (M, N)) ∧
      PublishedProjectionSquare f Λ d x o hL hR mY mX cY cX e a b
